notes.note: Francou left the game after catching a boot to the kneecap which caused him to be stretchered off in the last quarter. He will miss a few weeks with this now.
Francou continues to show some strong form with 22 disposals and 4 clearances this week. A solid addition to your bench if you can get him.
Francou's second game was another great one with 15 disposals and 5 tackles. If you needed a downgrade then he would be a great option.
Great debut for Francou who is a ball magnet. 18 disposals but he laid 9 tackles which led the game!
